name: Dover
long_description:
Dover is on a mission to help every company build an amazing team. Every founder and business leader should have the tools and support they need to hire the right talent — fast.

Dover combines powerful free software with flexible recruiting services to help startups and growing companies scale efficiently. Dover is built around two core offerings:

Free Recruiting Tools:
Dover's ATS is a lightweight but powerful applicant tracking system built for busy founders and hiring managers. It’s as easy to use as a spreadsheet but includes everything you need to manage your first 100 hires — without the bloat of traditional ATS platforms. Hundreds of companies use Dover’s free tools to streamline their hiring process and stay in control as they grow.

Recruiting Partner Marketplace:
When companies need help, Dover connects them with top-tier, fractional recruiters through our on-demand marketplace. Recruiting Partners are experienced, startup-savvy professionals who can step in quickly to manage sourcing, interviewing, closing, and more — without the cost or commitment of an agency or full-time hire.

Dover went through Y Combinator in 2019, and today 500+ companies use our product to run a better hiring process. We've raised $23M from top VCs.

launches.title: Dover: Recruiting partners
launches.body:
# tl;dr:

• Today, Dover is launching Recruiting Partners, connecting you with seasoned recruiters who work as an extension of your team.

• Get flexible, on-demand recruiting help from pros with 10-15 years of experience who've worked with top startups and tech companies.

• Scale your recruiting efforts up or down as needed, without the overhead of a full-time hire.

• Most companies spend an average of $80/hour. Start with as little as $800 (fully refundable deposit).

✨ If you're hiring, get matched with a recruiter at [dover.com/recruiter](http://dover.com/recruiter) ✨

# Dover Recruiting Partners

We're thrilled to launch Dover Recruiting Partners – our biggest update yet to how startups can hit their hiring goals and hire the best talent.

Over the past 5 years, Dover has helped 1500+ companies like Stripe, Scale AI, OpenSea, Benchling, and Vanta attract and hire top talent. Now, we’re introducing our most flexible and full-service hiring solution for startups: Dover Recruiting Partners.

# 🚀 What are Dover Recruiting Partners?

Dover Recruiting Partners are vetted fractional recruiters who can work as an extension of your team. We only accept the top 2% of recruiters.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84634&key=user_uploads/5516/5b78d9d2-2b56-4bf3-8c70-9d233f4a3396)

# Key features

1️⃣ On-demand expertise: Get help from experienced recruiters when you need it, without the overhead of a full-time hire. Perfect for startups and companies with variable hiring needs.

2️⃣ Flexible pricing: Ramp up or down based on your hiring needs – pay only for the hours you use.

3️⃣ Tech-enabled efficiency: Recruiters can use Dover’s ATS, Sourcing Extension, and other tools so they can focus on strategic work and keep their costs low.

4️⃣ Transparent metrics: We share cost-per-hire and fill rates for our recruiters before you hire them so you can find the perfect recruiter for you.

# 🤔 Why did we build this?

Recruiting consistently ranks as a top 3 problem for startups, regardless of their stage or industry. Before companies are big enough to justify hiring a full-time recruiter, they often have to resort to agencies.

We like to say with agencies, "You'll be unhappy either way"—either you won't make a hire and waste time, or you will make a hire and pay $30k+ per placement. There’s a reason you don’t hire engineers or marketers on “contingency.”

We wanted to provide a more flexible, higher-quality solution. Dover Recruiting Partners gives you access to top-tier recruiting talent without the long-term commitment or exorbitant fees. Our fractional recruiting model allows you to work with a separate expert recruiter for each role you're hiring for, whether it's a senior engineer, a sales leader, or a product manager.

# 💰 How much does it cost?

Most companies spend an average of $80 per hour, depending on the services they use. The cost per hire across the platform varies, but it usually ends up being between $4 and $7k.

# 🚀 How do I get started?

Head to [dover.com/recruiter](http://dover.com/recruiter) and click "Get matched with a recruiter". We'll set you up with a free call to understand your needs and match you with the perfect Recruiting Partner.

We're excited to help companies of all sizes build amazing teams. If you have any questions, drop them in the comments or email me directly at [max@dover.com](mailto:max@dover.com).

Read more about how we got here on our blog: <https://www.dover.com/blog/introducing-dover-recruiting-partners>

Happy hiring! 🎉

launches.title: AI Applicant Sorting by Dover
launches.tagline: Chat-powered assistant to help you review resumes 10x faster
launches.body:
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XDETxEtJiCQ&t=1s>

Applicant volume for roles in tech has risen 2.4x in 2023 from last year’s averages. Yet it’s harder to filter down to top candidates and you can’t get back to everyone. It sucks for candidates too — they never hear back, and candidate experience takes a hit.

The proprietary tech that powers our automated outbound sourcing engine is now applied to reveal top applicants across all your job boards. Use extremely powerful filters and chat to find candidates matching exactly what you’re looking for and review resumes 10x faster — for free.

**What is Dover?**

Over the last five years, Dover (YC S19) has enabled Scale AI, OpenSea, Benchling, Vanta, Stripe, and 500+ other startups to make thousands of hires. You may have seen some of our other launches like our [Applicant Tracking System](https://www.producthunt.com/products/dover#free-ats-by-dover) and [Sourcing Autopilot](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/dover-autopilot).

**What’s different from other resume review tools?**

Dover’s AI Applicant Sorting goes far beyond keywords. Dover has a knowledge graph of companies, industries, skillsets, and more.

AI Applicant Sorting allows you to use super powerful filters and chat to find candidates based on exactly what you’re looking for.

As you review candidates, quickly approve or reject with a click. Take bulk actions to send the next steps in a fraction of the time. Use hotkeys to speed up review time even more.

**What kinds of queries can I sort or filter by?**

It’s AI-powered, so you can get pretty nuanced:

* “6+ years experience”
* “based in the US or Canada”
* “candidates with a fintech background”
* "people with experience at B2C startups”
* “people who have worked on scalable systems”
* “full stack engineers or people with similar titles”
* “applicants who worked at well-reputed companies”
* "account executives with experience at SaaS startups"
* “product managers working in healthcare in San Francisco"
* “candidates with FAANG experience who went to a top school”
* "software engineers with at least 5 years of experience with React or Typescript experience"

**How hard is it to set up?**

Import existing applicants from your Applicant Tracking System or get new candidates by posting a job for free with Dover’s ATS, which has everything startups need to build a great recruiting process and candidate experience. It costs $0 and takes 10 minutes to set up.

Just want to try it out? Start using the tool with sample candidates in only a few minutes.

**How much does it cost?**

Dover’s AI Applicant Sorting is totally free to use, just like our Applicant Tracking System.

**Why is Dover releasing this for free?**

Dover’s mission is to help every company run an incredible hiring process and every candidate has a great experience. The best way to do this is by building easy-to-use tools to help every company get the basics right.

We make money by selling [Sourcing Autopilot](http://dover.com/sourcing-autopilot) and [Embedded Recruiter](http://dover.com/embedded-recruiter) to companies that need help with sourcing or full-cycle recruiting.

**How do you ensure the AI doesn’t create bias?**

If you throw AI at a problem, bias can be created. We’ve built this model by inputting specific data and criteria and examining what’s happening with the AI output. We use AI to make it faster and easier.

We built this feature to make sure you find people who should get a second look and to ensure everyone hears back from you. AI is used to sort candidates, Dover doesn’t autoreject based on its output.

**How do I get started?**

Get started [**here**](https://www.dover.com/ai-sorting?utm_source=bookface&utm_campaign=ai_sorting_bfwww.dover.com/ai-sorting?utm_source=bookface&utm_campaign=ai_sorting_bf).

If you’re interested in a demo or a white-glove onboarding, email [hello@dover.com](https://www.producthunt.com/products/dover#free-ats-by-dover)
